fields.description: Issue features editorials opposing a Florida state sales tax and criticizing newspaper influence and government reorganization proposals associated with the Hoover Commission, including a call for readers to petition Gov. Warren. Local civic and municipal coverage includes Miami civil service and city commission matters (including a lawsuit over payment of legal fees), discussion of gambling and slot machines in Florida, and crime/public safety reporting on gun availability and violence. Additional items address conditions at Jackson Memorial Hospital, unemployment trends in Dade County, marriage law changes in Florida, and tourism promotion through Delta Air Lines advertising for Miami.
